events.title: The Fall 2024 semester begins August 19 and ends December 11.
■ August 29 is the last day to withdraw and get a refund.
■ December 6 is the last day to withdraw from the course without receiving a let
■ The comprehensive final exam is Monday, December 9, from 2:00 to 3:50 pm.
■ No late work will be accepted after December 11.
